title: Beyond Oasis
subtitle: The prince and the armlet
summary: Beyond Oasis is Ancient's action adventure, first released for Mega Drive in Japan on 9 December 1994 as The Story of Thor.
body: Beyond Oasis is Ancient's action adventure, first released for Mega Drive in Japan on 9 December 1994 as The Story of Thor. Prince Ali discovers a golden armlet that allows him to summon spirits, drawing him into a struggle against the power of a silver armlet. The adventure presents its towns, wilderness and dungeons from above, with battles taking place directly in those spaces. Ali begins with a knife, but learning to combine physical movement with the help of his elemental companions gradually changes how he explores the island.

The armlet calls four spirits: Dytto, Efreet, Shade and Bow. Their powers are associated with water, fire, shadow and plants, and each opens possibilities in the environment as well as in combat. Finding an appropriate place to summon a spirit becomes part of solving a room. A companion may help Ali cross a barrier or deal with a threat that his knife cannot conveniently reach. The abilities build on one another as the journey continues, encouraging the player to reconsider the surroundings whenever another spirit joins him.

Ali's combat includes jumps and special movements alongside ordinary knife strikes. Other weapons, including swords, bows and bombs, provide useful alternatives but have limited uses, so picking one up also means deciding when to spend it. That contrast keeps the permanent knife relevant while giving found equipment a practical purpose. Yuzo Koshiro produced the game and composed its music, with Ayano Koshiro contributing its visual direction. The expressive characters and large animated enemies give its compact world a strong physical presence as the elemental abilities steadily expand the adventure.
